reason: My mom and aunts bring me thobes and jalabiyas every time they go back home, and I got a whole stack in Amman this summer for a fraction of $80. I might stop by after Friday prayer to look, but I don't actually need anything right now.
objection: Why pay $75 to $80 for an embroidered thobe here when I can get the same thing, honestly nicer, from family abroad for way less? And I have no idea yet if this is a real boutique that will still be there in six months or just a TikTok brand trying out a storefront.
would_change_my_mind: A last-minute need I can't wait on family for, like a wedding or henna night outfit I need in a specific size this week, and seeing in person that the embroidery and fabric are better quality than what I get back home.
